title: Dual Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $f:V\to\bbr$. For a linear functional $\psi:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$, its dual Fourier coefficient is the finite additive Fourier coefficient of $f$ against the character $x\mapsto(-1)^{\psi(x)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-vector space
